At the start of every session the GM rolls once for the Crawler turn order and prints it.\n+2. Exploration uses that order all session.\n+3. Combat initiative replaces it for that fight only. After the fight, play returns to session order, starting with the Crawler after the one whose turn triggered the fight.\n+\n+## Rules-lead defaults (Syndicate, for gaps Caleb didn't cover)\n+- A Crawler who joins mid-session goes to the end of the order.\n+- A dead, benched or Autopilot Crawler's slot is skipped, not re-rolled.
